title: Systems Engineer
description:
**systems engineer**
====================

**mission**
-----------


lens’s mission is to end traffic accidents. lens prevents accidents and saves lives by detecting hazards to prevent accidents before they happen.

**platform \& product**
-----------------------


lens detect scans cctv feeds on highways to identify hazards, in real\-time, before they become accidents. public safety agencies, alongside departments of transportation, receive alerts on the lens detect dashboard about disabled vehicles, stalled big rigs, and pedestrians on freeway. a dispatcher reviews and validates the detection, and then dispatches an officer to the scene to assist the person in need — resulting in either preventing an accident or saving a life.


cbs la recently did a three minute tv feature that succinctly captures what lens is doing with public safety agencies in one of the largest traffic capitals in the world:


chp la communications center using ai to prevent accidents before they happen

**role**
--------


you seek transformational change. you do not accept the status quo that accidents are an accepted inevitability, or that *they just happen*. instead, you believe when the root cause of an accident can be known in advance, the accident can and should be prevented. you work with fellow preventers that share this core belief, and together use lens to prevent accidents and save lives.

**role \& responsibilities**
----------------------------


as a systems engineer, you seek transformational change. you do not accept the status quo that accidents are an accepted inevitability, or that *they just happen*. instead, you believe when the root cause of an accident can be known in advance, the accident can and should be prevented. you work with fellow preventers that share this core belief, using lens to prevent accidents and save lives.your responsibilities are:

* increase the scale and speed of preventing accidents working closely with our co\-founder and cto to architect, build, operate, and scale lens. the lens platform consists of five layers: the data feed framework, lens specific ai, two other layers, and the application layer at the top. the first lens native application, lens detect, is a real\-time streaming application used by public safety agencies to detect pre\-accidents and dispatch officers to prevent accidents and save lives.
* you are part of an engineering function that is highly collaborative, operates with ai\-scale leverage, and can execute with both speed and quality.
* you will deliver highly reliable, scalable, and secure software that meets the demands of mission\-critical public safety agencies.
* you are leading by example \- building, and guiding the team to build, with the end in mind, as well enabling others to reach their highest creative frequency and impact. the team is expected to grow fast and you will grow with it.
* you work with fellow builders and preventers who share your commitment to excellence and your conviction that technology and ai should amplify human judgment, not replace it.

**mindset, principles, and skills \& experience**
-------------------------------------------------


your **mindset** is grounded in:

* systems reliability is a preventer's work. the agencies using lens depend on a platform that is always available, responsive and stable. we’re in the business of 24/7 first responder services.
* systems thinking across the entire platform. you see infrastructure, data pipelines, ai layers and real\-time applications interact. you anticipate dependencies, identify failure\-modes, and design systems that work together seamlessly.
* operational excellence. you approach incidents with clarity and composure. you diagnose issues methodically, communicate precisely, and restore stability without hesitation.

**principles** you share with us are:

* **we remove single points of failure and create safety nets.** you design systems with redundancy \- so that if one layer is tested, the next is already in place. no single misconfiguration, credential, or exposure becomes a mission\-ending event.
* **begin with the end in mind.** you identify the reliability, scalability, and operational posture lens needs to achieve \- real\-time responsiveness, agency trust, uninterrupted availability \- and work backwards to the architecture, controls, automation, and validation required to get there.
* **invest the most time where it makes the most progress.** you evaluate every system's investment by the risk it reduces and the mission impact it protects, prioritizing controls that eliminate any risk of interruptions.


the **skills \& experience** you have are:

* proficiency with python, c\+\+, cuda, javascript, go, kotlin, swift, typescript
* production experience with google cloud platform and/or aws
* comfortable working across the stack from low\-level systems to cloud infrastructure
* hands\-on experience with github actions and workflow design
* strong command of docker
* experience integrating with neo cloud apis
* proven ability to perform root\-cause analysis across complex, multi\-layered failures spanning sensors, compute units, and physical hardware
* experience with ml model optimization and metadata schema design
* working knowledge of transient real\-time data along immutable event and time\-series data
* experience with streaming video pipelines
* design systems with testability in mind
* messaging frameworks such as mqtt, rtps and ømq

  

the time to accept traffic accidents is ending, and the time to prevent them has begun. this belief is becoming more of an inevitable reality every day. the number of agencies lens serves keeps growing \- and the world needs to know why. if you want to shape the narrative of a company preventing accidents and saving lives, and use the power of communication to accelerate that mission, this role is for you.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
**description**at liberty mutual, technology isn't just a part of our business — it's what drives us forward. we deliver our customers peace of mind every day by helping them protect what they value most. our passion for placing the customer at the center of everything we do is driving a transformational shift at liberty mutual.

**u.s. based role only**

**we cannot consider candidates that require visa sponsorship or candidates that currently are on an f1 or opt visa.**

**this is a hybrid role requiring two days a week in the office (tech hub office locations are located in boston, portsmouth, indianapolis, columbus, and plano.)**


we are seeking a **senior data engineer** with strong analytical skills to join our growing data and analytics engineering team in the pl product/finance and vendor extract space. this is an exciting opportunity for an engineer who brings a blend of technical data engineering expertise and business analyst instincts — someone who not only builds data solutions but deeply understands the data they work with and the business problems they solve.


operating as an agile team within a fortune 100 company, you will be on the front edge of an it transformation, working collaboratively with business stakeholders, data scientists, and engineering peers to design and deliver high\-quality data solutions.

**key responsibilities**
------------------------

* design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines, data models, and integration processes using modern cloud\-based technologies (aws, snowflake, etc.)
* analyze complex data sets and technical problems to design effective, flexible, and innovative solutions that meet business needs
* collaborate closely with product owners, business stakeholders, and cross\-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical data solutions
* build and support etl/elt pipelines for structured and unstructured data from internal and external sources, including apis, flat files, and enterprise applications
* implement data quality checks, validation rules, reconciliations, exception handling, and monitoring to ensure data integrity
* develop automated tests across multiple scopes (unit, system, integration, regression) to ensure reliability and accuracy of data solutions
* perform data profiling, root cause analysis, and troubleshooting of data issues across production and non\-production environments
* document data flows, data dictionaries, and technical specifications to support data governance and knowledge sharing
* identify and recommend continuous improvement opportunities across data engineering processes and tooling
* collaborate with engineers and architects, and actively contribute to code reviews and engineering best practices
* leverage ai\-assisted development tools like github copilot
* actively uses ai tools to improve the speed, quality, and scale of work; can point to concrete workflows where ai adds value; critically evaluates and validates ai\-generated output; and applies ai responsibly, protecting confidential and customer data.

 **qualifications*** bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or a related technical or business discipline (or equivalent experience)
* 5\-6 years of experience in data engineering, data analytics, or a related technical role
* strong proficiency in **sql**, including writing complex queries, data modeling, and working with relational and analytical databases
* familiarity with cloud\-based data platforms and tools such as **snowflake**, **aws** or similar technologies
* curious and open to exploring some mainframe technologies
* strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to interpret and communicate data\-driven insights
* demonstrated ability to work in an **agile, squad\-based environment** with cross\-functional teams
* proactive, self\-motivated, and a logical thinker with strong attention to detail
* excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly convey technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders
* experience with data integration and etl/elt tools such as **idmc**
* familiarity with ci/cd pipelines, version control (git), and software development best practices

**preferred:**

* understanding of cloud / hybrid data architecture concepts
* exposure to data governance, data quality frameworks, or master data management concepts
* experience in the **insurance or financial services** industry is a plus

**about us****pay philosophy:** the typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. the full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. some roles at liberty mutual have a corresponding compensation plan which may include commission and/or bonus earnings at rates that vary based on multiple factors set forth in the compensation plan for the role.  

  

at liberty mutual, our goal is to create a workplace where everyone feels valued, supported, and can thrive. we build an environment that welcomes a wide range of perspectives and experiences, with inclusion embedded in every aspect of our culture and reflected in everyday interactions. this comes to life through comprehensive benefits, workplace flexibility, professional development opportunities, and a host of opportunities provided through our employee resource groups. each employee plays a role in creating our inclusive culture, which supports every individual to do their best work. together, we cultivate a community where everyone can make a meaningful impact for our business, our customers, and the communities we serve.

* experience with restful apis, graphql apis, and microservices architecture and apis at scale

**preferred**  

* knowledge and experience in high scale, highly available systems

* excellent problem\-solving skills
* curiosity and ability to learn new technologies and tool sets
* experience with nodejs technology stack and various databases
* familiarity with microservice architecture
* experience with cloud platforms like microsoft azure or aws
* care deeply about writing high\-performance, reusable code for components that will be used across our product
  

  

**wage transparency**
---------------------

  

  

  

pay for this position is based on a number of factors including geographic location and may vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

we are looking for an implementation engineer to join our field engineering organization. the implementation engineer (ie) is a customer\-facing technical partner who works closely with account teams and customers to drive successful implementations, accelerate platform adoption, and ensure measurable outcomes across the customer lifecycle.  



  

this role goes beyond traditional implementation delivery. it requires a blend of technical consulting, solution design, customer data strategy, and data analysis to support complex customer environments. the ie serves as a trusted advisor, helping customers solve technical challenges, optimize their platform use, and realize sustained business value through proactive engagement and guidance.

title: Sr Business Analyst, Applied Intelligence
description:
founded in 1977 as the senior care action network, scan began with a simple but radical idea: that older adults deserve to stay healthy and independent. that belief was championed by a group of community activists we still honor today as the “12 angry seniors.” their mission continues to guide everything we do.


today, scan is a nonprofit health organization serving more than 500,000 people across arizona, california, nevada, new mexico, texas, and washington, with over $8 billion in annual revenue. with nearly five decades of experience, we have built a distinctive, values\-driven platform dedicated to improving care for older adults.


our work spans medicare advantage, fully integrated care models, primary care, care for the most medically and socially complex populations, and next\-generation care delivery models. across all of this, we are united by a shared commitment: combining compassion with discipline, innovation with stewardship, and growth with integrity.


at scan, we believe scale should strengthen—not dilute—our mission. we are building the future of care for older adults, grounded in purpose, accountability, and respect for the people and communities we serve.

**the job**

  

the senior business analyst serves as the critical link between business stakeholders and technical teams (development, data science, data warehouse and infrastructure) by translating prioritized business needs into detailed technical and data requirements for proposed analytic solutions. the individual acts as a trusted advisor to technical delivery teams, applying back\-end data knowledge to ensure requirements are complete, feasible, and buildable, surfacing data quality, structure, and integration considerations early enough to prevent rework. this role is dedicated to supporting our operations (e.g., claim adjudication, payment integrity), experience (e.g., member call center, digital and member portal teams, member experience), and commercial (e.g., sales, marketing) teams, developing the domain depth in each area needed to translate business needs into technical designs that reflect how these teams' data and processes actually work. the senior business analyst shapes business use cases into the detailed specifications, data mappings, and technical designs that delivery teams need to execute.

 **you will**

* partners with business stakeholders, particularly in the member experience, operations and commercial functions to solve complex business problems by designing custom data and analytics solutions to support informed decision\-making in pursuit of critical outcomes for scan
* interprets and develops business requests into well\-defined requirements and acceptance criteria, using sound business acumen and deep understanding of data and technical platforms within the context of the operating environment.
* collaborate with development teams and stakeholders to identify business needs, evaluate ai\-driven and data analytics solutions, and recommend scalable technology approaches that align with business objectives, technical capabilities, and enterprise data strategy.
* responsible for exploratory data analysis, as well as creation of wireframes, mock\-ups, and proofs of concept to ensure the scope of work presented to delivery teams will meet the needs of the business.
* develop and maintain actionable hybrid functional design documents (fdds)/technical design documents (tdds), and user stories to support solution delivery, while serving as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams to clarify requirements, define business rules, and facilitate issue resolution throughout the development lifecycle.
* collaborate with development teams and stakeholders to identify business needs, evaluate ai\-driven and data analytics solutions, and recommend scalable technology approaches that align with business objectives, technical capabilities, and enterprise data strategy
* leads user acceptance testing (uat) along with business users against documented acceptance criteria and exercises judgement in considering modifications or enhancements that should be incorporated in the current development cycle.
* continuously expands expertise in business processes, applications, data domains, and industry practices to support effective requirements analysis, solution design, and stakeholder engagement.
* provides thought leadership and promotes best practices to deliver effective, user\-friendly and sustainable solutions.
* apply advanced analytic techniques to solve business problems and address needs.
* we seek rebels who are curious about ai and its power to transform how we operate and serve our members.
* actively support the achievement of scan’s vision and goals.
* other duties as assigned.

 **your qualifications**

* bachelor's degree in business, statistics, analytics, or technology related discipline or equivalent experience
* comfortable interviewing and presenting to all levels of management.
* experienced in creating best\-in\-class solutions with bi tools (e.g., power bi, tableau, ssrs) with demonstrated ability to design effective and easy to use interfaces for a wide range of personas.
* knowledge of operations and data utilized in medicare advantage or other managed care models, with emphasis on claims, coding, membership and experience datasets
* strong understanding of data warehousing concepts and familiarity with cloud platforms (microsoft azure, amazon web services (aws), google cloud platform (gcp), snowflake, databricks).
* experience with querying and manipulating data structures in on\-premises or cloud data warehouses (sql, snowflake, databricks, ssis).
* familiarity with ai tools and techniques, machine learning, data science, and advanced statistical techniques and concepts.
* able to work in a scaled agile framework.
* experienced working with both onshore and offshore development teams.
* understanding of health plan strategic objectives, especially around member experience
* ability to translate vague business questions into structured analytical problems, and work with technical colleagues to architect and deliver solutions

* **continuous learning:** our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. the real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast\-paced learning experience, owning your journey.

* **global community:** with colleagues across 65\+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
* **world\-class benefits:** on top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well\-being for you and your family.

* upcoming graduation between december 2026 and august 2027 with a master's, bachelor's or phd degree in computer science, machine learning, applied statistics, mathematics, engineering, artificial intelligence, or a related field
* professional experience applying machine learning, statistical modeling, optimization, or genai techniques to real business problems; proficiency in python and sql is required, including the python ai stack
* ability to translate business problems into analytical challenges, building and evaluating models across supervised, unsupervised, statistical, or forecasting approaches with guidance
* foundational understanding of optimization, simulation, and decision logic concepts, with the ability to apply methodologies with guidance
* developing familiarity with generative ai tools and simple agentic ai frameworks, with an eagerness to learn how llms can be applied to automate defined tasks
* a quality and risk mindset: able to validate own work, document assumptions and limitations, and apply basic evaluation methods for prompts, rag models, or agents; growing awareness of fairness, explainability, and human oversight considerations
* follows software development and mlops/llmops best practices with guidance, with introductory exposure to ci/cd and agentic engineering concepts
* exceptional time management to meet your responsibilities in a complex and largely autonomous work environment
* willingness to travel

title: Senior Software Engineer (West Coast USA)
description:
**about misumi americas**


misumi americas, a division of misumi group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. by integrating a vast catalog of components with a world\-class digital manufacturing platform, misumi americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. with operations in the san francisco bay area and chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the americas.


**senior software engineer**
============================


**location:** remote (west coast usa)


**company:** misumi americas


**please note: final\-round interviews will be conducted in person in either oakland, california, or portland, oregon.**


**build the future of manufacturing**
-------------------------------------


manufacturing is a $13 trillion industry, and most of it is still held together by spreadsheets, phone calls, and fax machines. misumi americas is rewriting that.


we've been building a cloud\-based, ai\-powered digital manufacturing platform that takes companies from prototype to production faster than the industry thought possible. our platform pairs intelligent software with a global network of vetted manufacturing partners, powering innovation across electric vehicles, robotics, and next\-generation consumer products.


we're scaling fast, and we're looking for engineers who'd rather untangle hard, real\-world problems than push pixels on a toy app.


you'll join the team that owns costing, pricing, lead time, and dfm (design for manufacturability) for our instant quoting platform. when a customer uploads a part, our systems decide what it costs, when it ships, and whether it can be made. accuracy matters; our output directly drives revenue and customer trust.


we build with ai agents as a core part of how we work. we're looking for strong engineers who use agents to plan, implement, and test faster, and who have the judgment to know when the output is wrong.


**what you'll do**
------------------


as a senior backend engineer, you'll help build and scale the systems running our global manufacturing ecosystem:


* design and develop highly available, scalable backend services in aws
* build and maintain event\-driven, asynchronous systems using node.js
* create robust apis (rest / graphql) powering customer\-facing and internal tools
* use ai coding agents to take features from design through implementation and testing, while owning the correctness of every change
* write specs, tests, and repo context that make agent\-driven development reliable in a large, established codebase
* partner closely with product, frontend, and infrastructure teams to ship features that actually move the business
* contribute to technical design discussions and drive best practices across the team
* help shape how the team works with ai: sharing patterns, tooling, and lessons learned
* debug production issues and improve system reliability
* continuously improve code quality through testing, observability, and documentation

**what you bring**
------------------


* 5 \+ years of backend engineering experience
* strong skills in node.js, javascript/typescript
* experience building systems on aws (sqs, lambda, ec2, rds, etc.)
* solid understanding of distributed systems and event\-driven architectures
* experience designing and maintaining rest or graphql apis
* familiarity with sql and nosql databases
* a commitment to writing unit and integration tests
* knowledge of system design, caching, and security best practices (owasp top 10\)
* hands\-on experience shipping production code with ai coding agents (e.g., claude code, cursor, copilot agent mode), with clear examples of where you had to step in, correct, or override them
* strong code review skills, applied just as rigorously to ai\-generated changes
* **must be a u.s. citizen or lawful permanent resident (green card holder)**

**nice to have:**


* aws certification
* experience with high\-scale or business\-critical systems
* experience with pricing, quoting, or other numerically sensitive business logic
* experience building agent workflows, custom tools, or mcp integrations for your team

**how you work**
----------------


* you take ownership and ship clean, maintainable, production\-ready code
* you treat ai as a force multiplier, not a substitute for understanding the system
* you communicate clearly and collaborate across teams
* you solve problems proactively, even outside your immediate scope
* you enjoy mentoring others and raising the bar for engineering excellence
* you stay curious and keep learning new technologies and patterns

**why misumi americas?**
------------------------


* work on real\-world problems impacting global supply chains
* join a fast\-growing company at the intersection of ai, software, and manufacturing
* collaborate with teams building products used by top hardware innovators
* competitive compensation and benefits
* flexible, west coast\-friendly work environment
* minimal travel (0–10%)

**ready to build something that matters?**
------------------------------------------


if scaling systems, solving hard problems, and shaping the future of manufacturing sounds like your kind of work, we want to hear from you.


**salary range:** $160,000 – $200,000 per year, depending on experience


we’re actively seeking teammates who:


* bring diverse perspectives and experience to our culture and company.
* excel at being part of a strong, empathetic team.
* thrive in an environment emphasizing respect, honesty, collaboration, and growth.
* have an ‘always learning’ mindset that celebrates learning, not just wins.
* help us continue to build a world\-class organization that values the contributions of all of our teammates

we encourage applications from members of underrepresented groups, including but not limited to women, members of the lgbtq community, people of color, people with disabilities, and veterans.

**who we are**
  

  

colgate\-palmolive company is a global consumer products company operating in over 200 countries specializing in oral care, personal care, home care, skin care, and pet nutrition. our products are trusted in more households than any other brand in the world, making us a household name!

**role summary**
we are looking for a highly motivated senior platform engineer to design, build, and continually modernize our internal development platform using gcp native technologies and kubernetes. this individual will partner directly with the existing lead senior platform engineer to co\-drive the platform strategy, foster innovation, and lead agentic software development initiatives. this role bridges the gap between our development teams and the underlying infrastructure, enabling teams to build fast, reliable, secure, and standardized software. you will provide strategic leadership and high\-level architectural oversight, empowering developers by building automated "golden paths" and self\-service tools that abstract away infrastructure complexities and reduce cognitive load.  

you will serve as a member of our open source program office, acting as the internal expert to build out our open source strategy and support teams on open source software adoption and processes.  

**responsibilities:**
* **strategic leadership \& partnership:** partner with engineering leadership to define and execute the long\-term platform roadmap. drive collaborative decision\-making across the organization, influencing technical strategy and ensuring high\-level architectural alignment with business goals.
* **centralized tooling management:** this person will be responsible for centralized platforms and tooling provided to the development teams across the organization, such as github, sentry, sonarqube, hashicorp vault, terraform and other platforms developed by the team.
* **platform modernization \& scaling:** design, implement, and maintain scalable infrastructure and cloud resources within gcp. ensure systems scale efficiently as traffic grows, continually optimizing the platform for peak performance and reliability.
* **architecture \& devsecops collaboration:** partner closely with the architecture and cloud teams to develop coding standards, guidelines, and our devsecops process. work across departments to ensure these standards help deliver secure, reliable, and scalable solutions across both traditional and modern cloud\-native technologies.
* **golden paths \& self\-service:** create standardized workflows, "golden images/paths," and self\-service options leveraging ai and modern software practices to empower development and business teams. champion automation for infrastructure provisioning, ci/cd pipelines, and configuration management to minimize manual tasks and errors.
* **agentic software \& platform development:** lead and drive the development of team\-owned platforms, including building intelligent agents for internal architecture and security review processes. design and support advanced cloud management platforms that leverage agentic workflows to enhance organizational efficiency and security posture.
* **kubernetes maintenance \& troubleshooting:** manage and maintain our kubernetes instances and containerized workloads. provide hands\-on incident management, debugging, and troubleshooting to assist teams and quickly resolve complex system issues.
* **open source program management:** define, implement, and communicate our internal and external open source strategy, policies, and management processes. serve as the resident expert to support multi\-functional teams on open source software tooling, dependency management, and best practices.
* **security \& compliance:** integrate security directly into the platform by managing access controls, applying best practices, and ensuring that open source and internal software consistently comply with industry standards.
* **collaboration \& knowledge sharing:** work closely with cross\-functional teams to understand their needs, create detailed technical documentation, and lead knowledge\-sharing or training sessions to reduce tribal knowledge.

**required qualifications:**
* 6\+ years of experience in a software engineering or platform engineering role.
* completed bachelors degree

**preferred qualifications:**  

  

* proficiency in low\-level coding and scripting languages (e.g., python, javascript(reactjs)) for building automations and debugging complex systems.
* knowledge of open source releases, dependency management tools, and version control best practices (e.g., github).
* experience with monitoring, observability, and logging tools (such as sentry, datadog, grafana, or elk) to proactively identify issues before they impact service.
* strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse stakeholders.
* knowledge in cloud computing (gcp) and kubernetes/container orchestration, including hands\-on experience managing production clusters.
* experience using infrastructure as code (iac) tools like terraform and managing ci/cd pipelines.
* experience defining development policies, standardizing workflows, and actively reducing technical debt.
* knowledge / experience with ai development tools, processes and implementation workflows.
* a proven track record of project leadership, mentorship, and conducting training for software engineers.
* aws knowledge and experience

* **contribute to ai agent development:** assist with the design, configuration, development, and testing of enterprise ai agents and copilots using microsoft copilot studio, azure ai technologies, python, apis, and related tools.

================


* **education:** currently pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, data science, artificial intelligence, machine learning, software engineering, information systems, engineering, or a related field. candidate should remain enrolled in an academic program after the internship.

* **programming skills:** experience with at least one programming language used for data or application development, preferably c\# or python. ability to write understandable, maintainable code and troubleshoot technical issues.
* **communication skills:** strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* **collaboration and learning:** curiosity, initiative, attention to detail, willingness to learn, and ability to work effectively with cross\-functional teams in a fast\-moving environment.

**preferred skills (bonus)**

* experience designing test cases or evaluating ai/ml systems for accuracy, reliability, or responsible use.
* awareness of ai ethics, privacy, security, governance, and the importance of human oversight in enterprise or regulated environments.
* previous internship, research, hackathon, or substantial academic project involving ai, data, automation, or software development.

**what you will learn**
=======================


* how enterprise generative ai solutions are identified, designed, built, tested, governed, deployed, and improved.
* how agents use trusted enterprise data, retrieval, apis, citations, and controls to produce grounded responses.

**libertyville, illinois, usa** – this internship is based at the libertyville office and requires regular in\-person collaboration with the team during summer 2027\. specific hybrid\-work expectations will be confirmed during the recruiting process. relocation assistance, housing, and transportation are not provided for this opportunity.

title: Information Technology Architect | (Cloud Engineer)
description:
**information technology architect (cloud engineer)**

**general description and classification standards:**

the information technology architect (cloud engineer) in the enterprise data services (eds) team, within the office of technology and digital experience (tde), is responsible for architecting, engineering, and operating the cloud and database platforms that support the department of aviation’s enterprise data and ai initiatives. this hybrid role combines cloud engineering with database administration: enabling secure, scalable cloud services while administering oracle, sql server, and cloud\-managed database systems, including design, development, implementation, capacity planning, monitoring for availability, performance tuning, backup and recovery, security, upgrades, and troubleshooting.  



the ideal candidate brings a strong foundation in data engineering and cloud infrastructure, along with the ability to design and deliver reliable, secure, and cost\-effective data platforms that keep airport systems available 24 x 7 x 365 while enabling the airport’s analytics, automation, and ai roadmap.  



**supervision received:**

reports to the information technology director ii, enterprise data services, and works with minimal supervision, using independent judgment and initiative. makes decisions on process and procedure improvements, solutions to reduce system downtime, system maintenance to improve performance and availability, and hardware and software for databases and database application servers. provides advice on system upgrades and new technology implementation.  



**essential duties and responsibilities:**

*these are typical responsibilities for this position and should not be construed as exclusive or all inclusive.*

* **cloud architecture \& engineering**
	+ design, build, and maintain cloud architectures, landing zones, and reference designs for enterprise data services, aligned with eds standards, security requirements, and the enterprise data and ai roadmap.
	+ enable and manage cloud services, including compute, storage, networking, identity, and managed database and analytics services, for airport applications and data workloads.
	+ plan and execute migrations of on\-premises databases and applications to cloud platforms, including assessment, sizing, cutover, and validation.
	+ automate provisioning, configuration, and deployment using scripting, infrastructure as code, and ci/cd pipelines.
	+ monitor and optimize cloud consumption and costs, and recommend right\-sizing, reservation, and licensing strategies.
* **database administration \& operations**
	+ administer and maintain day\-to\-day operations of oracle, sql server, and cloud\-managed databases, services, and software, including creating user accounts, assigning permissions and schemas, and creating tables and fields.
	+ configure and maintain database software and environments, ensuring data remains consistent, accurate, and clearly defined, and that security levels comply with division and department standards and procedures.
	+ monitor the overall health, availability, and performance of database systems, services, and data flow, and take corrective action as required to ensure reliable performance.
	+ perform installation, upgrades, patching, capacity planning, and performance tuning, and resolve database performance, capacity, replication, and other distributed data issues.
	+ develop and implement data models, database designs, data access code, and table maintenance code, documenting how data elements are defined and used.
* **backup, recovery \& availability**
	+ plan, schedule, and verify backup and recovery procedures, and ensure that required backups are completed.
	+ restore failed production databases and services through the disaster recovery process, and design high availability and disaster recovery solutions across on\-premises and cloud environments.
	+ act as a member of a team to ensure 24 x 7 x 365 availability of the department’s enterprise database systems and cloud services.
* **security \& compliance**
	+ plan, coordinate, and implement security measures, including access controls, encryption, and auditing, to safeguard information against accidental or unauthorized damage, modification, or disclosure.
	+ develop standards and guidelines to guide the use and acquisition of software and to protect vulnerable information.
	+ ensure cloud and database environments meet security, compliance, and operational resilience requirements, including the protection of sensitive security information (ssi), controlled unclassified information (cui), personally identifiable information (pii), and critical infrastructure data.
	+ ensure databases and software applications are patched and upgraded to current supported product versions.
* **data platform \& ai enablement**
	+ architect and support the data platforms that power enterprise reporting, analytics, and the ai roadmap, including data integration, pipelines, data warehouses, and secure environments for ai and machine learning workloads.
	+ partner with data engineers, bi engineers, and analysts to ensure data availability, performance, quality, and consistency across enterprise data services.
	+ support data governance initiatives, including metadata, lineage, data quality, and access management.
* **application \& systems support**
	+ databricks/lakehouse architecture
	+ azure architecture
	+ data modeling
	+ apis/events
	+ data governance
	+ integration patterns
	+ research and resolve problems, coordinate activities with it support staff as required, and document findings.
	+ respond to and resolve, or ensure resolution of, issues assigned by the help desk.
* **documentation \& standards**
	+ create procedures and process documentation for database and cloud standards.
	+ write technical and end\-user documentation for assigned projects, including architecture diagrams, data models, and runbooks.
	+ follow the division team handbook, policies and procedures, software standards, software development lifecycle, and change management.
* **collaboration \& continuous improvement**
	+ serve as the eds representative for the assigned area, acting as a liaison to business units and delivering customer\-focused, responsive service.
	+ analyze and recommend functional and technical process improvements, and stay current on oracle, sql server, cloud platform features, and development tools.
	support and assist with the strategic objectives and wildly important goals (wigs) of the division and the department of aviation.  
	+

**additional responsibilities**

* participate in the on\-call rotation as scheduled or requested, and respond to after\-hours emergencies as needed.
* prepare management reports related to system audit, availability, performance, and cloud costs as needed.
may perform other duties as assigned.  
* 

*the above statements reflect the general duties, responsibilities and competencies considered necessary to perform the essential duties and responsibilities of the job and should not be considered as a detailed description of all the work requirements of the position. coa may change the specific job duties with or without prior notice based on the needs of the organization.*

**knowledge skills and abilities:**

*this is a partial listing of necessary knowledge, skills, and abilities required to perform the job successfully, it is not an exhaustive list.*

* cloud architecture \& engineering: knowledge of cloud computing, networking, identity, and managed data services on platforms such as microsoft azure and aws, and the ability to design secure, scalable architectures.
* database administration: strong background in oracle and sql server administration, including sql, pl/sql, and t\-sql, performance tuning, replication, and backup and recovery.
* systems \& security: high\-level understanding of system architectures, storage, and database and cloud security practices, with working knowledge of azure environment.
* automation \& tooling: proficiency with scripting and infrastructure as code (e.g., powershell, python, terraform) and with monitoring and database management tools such as oracle enterprise manager and toad.
* project management: ability to manage multiple projects and tasks concurrently and to prioritize effectively.
* problem\-solving \& initiative: self\-starter able to use judgment and initiative to undertake activities and resolve complex technical problems with minimal supervision.
* communication \& customer service: excellent oral and written communication skills, the ability to work alone or within a team, and a customer\-focused, responsive approach when serving business units.
* vendor management: experience maintaining software licenses and managing vendor maintenance and support agreements.
availability \& flexibility: willingness to work extra hours as needed, participate in an on\-call rotation, and respond to after\-hours emergencies.  
* 

* **industry experience:** aviation, transportation, or public sector experience with knowledge of faa and tsa requirements, cybersecurity standards, and airport it ecosystems.
* **cloud architecture:** experience designing and migrating enterprise workloads and databases to microsoft azure, aws, or similar cloud platforms, including networking, identity, and landing zone design.
* **database platforms:** experience with oracle, sql server, and cloud\-managed database services, including high availability, replication, backup and recovery, and performance tuning.
* **automation \& infrastructure as code:** experience with scripting (powershell, python, shell), infrastructure as code (e.g., terraform, bicep), and ci/cd and devops practices.
* **vendor \& cost management:** experience managing software licenses, vendor support agreements, and cloud consumption costs (finops).

typical office setting, with participation in an on\-call rotation and after\-hours support as scheduled or requested.

natera is a global leader in cell\-free dna testing, supporting oncology, women's health, and organ health. our goal in r\&d operations data science is to support r\&d activities at natera through data analytics and the development of intelligent tools to optimize workflows and processes.

* **data pipeline \& sql engineering:** extract, clean, transform, and model complex multi\-source r\&d data. develop and optimize high\-performance custom sql queries and partner with data engineers to enhance database scalability and platform performance

**qualifications:**

* **experience:** 2\+ years of experience in data analysis, analytics engineering, or software/data platform development

* **analytical rigor \& data validation:** strong analytical intuition and critical thinking skills, with a proven ability to independently evaluate, verify, and fine\-tune data workflows, queries, and automated outputs to maintain high standards of quality and accuracy

natera™ is a global leader in cell\-free dna (cfdna) testing, dedicated to oncology, women's health, and organ health. our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

· core backlog reports shipping as excel \+ email digests james actually uses.

· bom / article loader path live under human approval.

**must\-haves**

· hands\-on experience running open\-weight llms on nvidia hardware (ollama, vllm, tensorrt\-llm, or similar) — not only cloud saas prompt engineering.

· strong sql and willingness to live inside a mature erp schema (macola / similar manufacturing erp is a plus; you will learn ours fast).

title: AI-Forward Engineer, NimbleRx
description:
at swoop, our mission is simple: improving patient outcomes. as a market leader in ai\-driven, data\-powered, and privacy\-compliant healthcare engagement, we connect the signals that drive earlier diagnosis, better treatment decisions, and sustained adherence.

  

our integrated, privacy\-safe platform, enables life sciences companies to drive measurable patient and commercial outcomes with actionable intelligence — spanning patient and hcp audience targeting, community engagement, ai\-powered web solutions, coordinated omnichannel activation, and prescription fulfillment.

  

we believe our people are our greatest asset. swoop fosters a culture of innovation and continuous learning, providing employees with rich opportunities for professional growth. this commitment to our team earned us the "best places to work" recognition from business intelligence group in 2025 and 2026\. we are driven by a patient\-first philosophy and passionate about leveraging technology to create a healthier future.

  

after becoming an independent company in 2024, swoop experienced significant growth and demonstrated an unwavering commitment to innovation, talent development, and enhancing the patient experience. our acquisition of myhealthteam in january 2025 and nimble in may 2026 helped us further bridging the gap between healthcare brands and patients for more impactful and targeted engagement. empowering millions of patients nationwide to connect, share resources, and access medically verified information to better manage their health. myhealthteam hosts the largest and most engaged patient social networks in healthcare, offering more than 70 condition\-specific communities for chronic and rare conditions. as a prescription fulfillment and patient engagement platform, nimble empowers independent and regional pharmacies to deliver a modern, consumer\-friendly healthcare experience while streamlining pharmacy operations.

  

if you're a driven professional seeking to make a real difference in healthcare marketing at a fast\-growing, innovative company, join swoop and help us revolutionize how brands connect with patients and hcps.

 **about the role**


your name may not start with a(ndrej) or b(oris), but hey, we are not hiring for a/b testing.

  

as an ai\-forward engineer, you will be at the frontier of how ai transforms every function in our startup. you will experiment with, evaluate, and implement ai\-powered tools and workflows that accelerate teams across product, engineering, data, design, as well as sales, operations, customer success, and product marketing.

  

the ai landscape evolves weekly — you will be our vanguard: rapidly prototyping with products, then shipping the integrations that give our teams an unfair advantage. a successful candidate combines solid software engineering fundamentals with deep curiosity about the ai ecosystem and a drive to put the best tools in the hands of every team.

  

our engineering culture: we operate with shared trust and no egos. we enjoy being “in this together” and collaborating on the challenges of a rapidly scaling business. we live out our company values of curiosity, ownership, simplicity, and gsd (get stuff done).

 **what you'll do**

* work closely with every function (product, engineering, data, design, operations, sales, and product marketing) to discover pain points and translate them into ai\-enabled solutions.
* experiment with and implement ai\-assisted developer tooling, leveraging claude code for agentic coding workflows and ai\-enhanced ci/cd pipelines that help engineering teams ship faster with higher confidence.
* leverage frontier models (claude, gemini, kimi, gpt) as core engineering tools, evaluating new model releases for coding, reasoning, and agentic capabilities, and integrating the best\-fit models into team workflows as they evolve.
* build and evolve our ai\-augmented testing pipeline: from product spec use cases through test cases, test data, unit tests, and end\-to\-end playwright automation, all generated via claude code, plus large\-scale codebase improvement and refactoring through ast\-based tooling (java/spoon, typescript/oxc, flutter dart analyzer).
* evaluate and deploy ai\-powered design tools, such as figma, pencil, stitch, veo, and nano banana.
* integrate ai\-native intelligence platforms into go\-to\-market, operations, customer success, and support workflows.
* stay on the leading edge of the ai tool landscape: continuously scouting, testing, and benchmarking new tools as they emerge weekly.
* create internal tools and interfaces (chat\-based assistants, dashboards, browser extensions, slack integrations) that make ai capabilities accessible to nontechnical stakeholders.
* establish best practices for agentic engineering, model evaluation, cost management, security, and responsible ai use across the organization.
* instrument and monitor ai\-powered systems for reliability, accuracy, and cost\-effectiveness.

 **qualifications**

* 2\+ years in engineering or devops roles — you know how software gets built, tested, and shipped
* well\-versed in multiple programming languages including typescript, java, and python
* hands\-on experience with terraform, github flows/actions, and ci/cd pipelines, and an instinct for where ai can accelerate them
* knowledge of aws
* already building with ai, whether it’s frontier models like claude, kimi, or gemini; agentic coding tools; or something you hacked together last weekend
* comfort working across teams that don’t speak your language (product, data, design, sales, ops) and translating their pain into working tools
* a tinkerer’s obsession — show us what you’ve built
* bias for shipping over perfecting — you’d rather demo a rough v1 in an hour than a polished v3 next week

  

open to engineer, senior, or lead candidates. what matters is what you could build, not your current title. **please note:*** applications need to include links to your github repos \-\> show us what you’ve built.
* this hybrid role is based in redwood city, california. two to three days in the office weekly is required.


the pay range for this role is:
152,000 \- 285,000 usd per year (hybrid (redwood city, ca, us))

title: Senior Clinical Data Scientist with advanced analytics experience
description:
job summary

innovet health is seeking a senior clinical data scientist to support high\-priority clinical informatics, interoperability, and analytics modernization initiatives for the u.s. department of veterans affairs (va). this role supports enterprise efforts related to ehr modernization, standards\-based interoperability, clinical workflow optimization, and data\-driven decision\-making across agile delivery environments.

the senior clinical data scientist will serve as the technical lead for advanced analytics, predictive modeling, and machine learning initiatives. the ideal candidate will bring experience working with va clinical systems, healthcare interoperability standards, enterprise data platforms, and cross\-functional agile teams to deliver actionable insights that improve veteran care, usability, and operational performance.

this is a **full\-time, remote position** with competitive pay, comprehensive benefits, and significant growth potential. you will have the chance to make a meaningful impact while enjoying the flexibility of working from home.

if you're ready to take your career to the next level in the federal sector, we'd love to hear from you. please send your resume and interest to **hr@innovethealth.com**.
